Block 3 — Endocrine · Slide-only adaptive question bank

441 quiz questions installed. 338 written questions plus 103 cover/reveal picture questions. Written questions come only from the Day 1–4 lecture files and reference the corresponding master-deck slide number. Master slides 21, 26, 62, and 134 are reserved for the independent interactive Chart Review and are not part of normal quiz coverage.

Adaptive mastery: a missed question enters the Incorrect Bank. You can manually remove it at any time, or let it stay there until you answer it correctly 3 times in a row. Adaptive quizzes deliberately pull bank questions more often until they are mastered.

Coverage rule: questions you answer correctly and that are not in the active Incorrect Bank will not recycle until every question in your selected test pool has been shown once. The only exception is an active Incorrect Bank question, which may repeat sooner so you can reach the 3-correct mastery streak.
